Docs/Replay/Guide

Replay

Cavecrawl floor-state acceptance

1 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓

Check which player values survive descent and which reset on another run. The suite compares complete replayed state/events and inspects actual Godot transition frames, including converted historical archives.

Shell
REPLAY_CAVE_FLOOR_OUT=/absolute/fresh/output nix develop --command bash tests/replay_cave_floor/run.sh

Runs Cave tests, an isolated game build, all fifteen C1–C7 conversion/resume fixtures, actual Godot descent/restart checks, and normal/faulted full campaigns. Test-only floor_value reads retained authority frames; it does not set gameplay values. The transition cases resume genuine C4 fixture archives under the new content, then exercise ordinary descent and the public restart action.

The legacy producer requires C4. Its actual files, log and frozen model source archive are retained in tests/replay_cave/fixtures/content4. Regenerate only against that archived model in a temporary collection overlay. Existing saved injury/timers/ledger remain intact through conversion, including already-reset post-descent values which cannot be retrospectively reconstructed.

The original host descent/restart and owner position-edge procedures provide the source contract. Pure tests verify tick decay/regeneration, active-effect retention, reserved respawn progress and complete world/event equality after input revision. The existing shared checkpoint-service and browser social/handoff gates validate C5 deployment compatibility separately. See the behavior guide.
